messages.text: Is it quiet enough to run in my office?

**Yes — it's genuinely office-friendly.**

- **~40–45 dB** at full speed (think quiet room / library background hum)
- **Small:** ~20 × 11 × 5.8 cm, **0.5 kg** — sits on its included stand on your desk
- The spring-mounted heatsink lets one large, slow fan do the work — no screaming tiny fan

The secret is the big heatsink: more surface area = slower fan = less noise. At eco mode (~4.8 TH/s / ~71 W) it's even quieter.

No published mic-distance, so "silent" would be overselling it — but plenty of owners run these alongside them all day without issue.
